title: Add DoseTimingCalculator -- the double-dose-prevention logic
description: Pure-function logic computing whether a candidate dose time is eligible given the medication's most recent prior dose and its minimum interval. This is the app's core double-dose-prevention feature, so it must be exact_code (not model-inferred): a sealed DoseTimingResult (Eligible or TooSoon(minutesRemaining)) and two pure functions, computeNextEligible and evaluateTiming.
acceptance_criteria: sealed class DoseTimingResult with object Eligible and data class TooSoon(val minutesRemaining: Long)

object DoseTimingCalculator with fun computeNextEligible(givenAtEpochMillis: Long, minIntervalMinutes: Int?): Long? returning null when minIntervalMinutes is null, otherwise givenAtEpochMillis + minIntervalMinutes * 60_000L

fun evaluateTiming(candidateEpochMillis: Long, mostRecentDose: DoseLog?, minIntervalMinutes: Int?): DoseTimingResult returning Eligible when mostRecentDose is null, when minIntervalMinutes is null, or when candidateEpochMillis is at or after the computed next-eligible time; otherwise TooSoon with minutesRemaining rounded up to the nearest whole minute
Valid Kotlin under package com.taylordproductivty.med_timing_tracker.data referencing the DoseLog entity from the same package
